Layout scene objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_scene.Rd

The object for the figure layout's scene (and scene2, scene3, ...: see update_scenes()). go_scene() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_scene(
  ...,
  annotations = NULL,
  aspectmode = NULL,
  aspectratio = NULL,
  bgcolor = NULL,
  camera = NULL,
  domain = NULL,
  dragmode = NULL,
  hovermode = NULL,
  uirevision = NULL,
  xaxis = NULL,
  yaxis = NULL,
  zaxis = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

annotations

List, each element a go_scene_annotation() object or named list, with properties align, arrowcolor, arrowhead, arrowside, arrowsize, arrowwidth, ax, ay, bgcolor, bordercolor, borderpad, borderwidth and 25 more (see go_scene_annotation()).

aspectmode

If "cube", this scene's axes are drawn as a cube, regardless of the axes' ranges. If "data", this scene's axes are drawn in proportion with the axes' ranges. If "manual", this scene's axes are drawn in proportion with the input of "aspectratio" (the default behavior if "aspectratio" is provided). If "auto", this scene's axes are drawn using the results of "data" except when one axis is more than four times the size of the two others, where in that case the results of "cube" are used. One of "auto", "cube", "data", "manual".

aspectratio

Sets this scene's axis aspectratio. A go_scene_aspectratio() object or named list, with properties x, y and z (see go_scene_aspectratio()).

bgcolor

Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

camera

A go_scene_camera() object or named list, with properties center, eye, projection and up (see go_scene_camera()).

domain

A go_domain() object or named list, with properties column, row, x and y (see go_domain()).

dragmode

Determines the mode of drag interactions for this scene. One of "orbit", "turntable", "zoom", "pan", FALSE.

hovermode

Determines the mode of hover interactions for this scene. One of "closest", FALSE.

uirevision

Controls persistence of user-driven changes in camera attributes. Defaults to `layout.uirevision`. Any value.

xaxis

A go_scene_axis() object or named list, with properties autorange, autorangeoptions, autotypenumbers, backgroundcolor, calendar, categoryarray, categoryorder, color, dtick, exponentformat, gridcolor, gridwidth and 44 more (see go_scene_axis()).

yaxis

A go_scene_axis() object or named list, with properties autorange, autorangeoptions, autotypenumbers, backgroundcolor, calendar, categoryarray, categoryorder, color, dtick, exponentformat, gridcolor, gridwidth and 44 more (see go_scene_axis()).

zaxis

A go_scene_axis() object or named list, with properties autorange, autorangeoptions, autotypenumbers, backgroundcolor, calendar, categoryarray, categoryorder, color, dtick, exponentformat, gridcolor, gridwidth and 44 more (see go_scene_axis()).

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_layout_scene object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter3d(x = ~wt, y = ~hp, z = ~mpg) |>
  update_layout(scene = go_scene(bgcolor = "lightyellow"))
